description: Test suite for scheduled post API endpoints in Mattermost, including create, update, and delete operations with permission checks.

methods.name: TestUpdateScheduledPost
methods.description: Tests that updating a scheduled post by a non-owner is forbidden and that the post remains unchanged.

methods.name: TestDeleteScheduledPost
methods.description: Tests that deleting a scheduled post by a non-owner is forbidden and that the post remains in the store.

methods.name: TestCreateScheduledPost
methods.description: Tests creating a scheduled post in a normal channel and in a read-only channel with permission restrictions.
